Algorithmic reference implementation of SAMK using BFV, Paillier, and polynomial interpolation under the published honest-but-curious, no-server-client-collusion threat model. The advisor-sized profile uses BFV N=2048 with a 54-bit coefficient modulus and a 3072-bit Paillier modulus target. These parameter sizes target conventional 128-bit-classical security conventions, but the custom Python implementation is not a certified SEAL/OpenFHE deployment or an optimized production performance benchmark.

Dedicated SAMK availability test: pre-upload dropout removes non-uploaders from the protected aggregate and re-forms the closed session without tier downgrade; a post-upload delayed uploader may recover the already-formed package later. This is a reference-workflow robustness test, not an SLA.
